items.source: The name of the index to use.

The name of the index to use. In case of an aggregation the index is evaluated against the initial
collection or view.
items.translation: 要使用的索引名称。如果是聚合操作，则针对初始集合或视图评估该索引。

items.source:
Annotation to declare index hints for repository query, update and aggregate operations. The index is specified by
its name.
items.translation: 用于声明仓库查询、更新和聚合操作的索引提示的注解。索引由其名称指定。
